name: Hentai Kazoku Roshutsu Yuugi
original_name: 変態家族 露出遊戯
source:
Kamiya Yuki is not an ordinary girl...
She is a perverted girl who recognizes it herself and in others. Moreover, on a day when the whole family is transformed, daily life is not understood.

Perverted enough that even the teacher notices it at school.
Nevertheless she still lives life happily everyday!

When such a family goes on a hot spring trip, I don't know what will happen there!
Now, what kind of incident filled journey is waiting there for them...

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ086023.html]DLsite Maniax[/url]]
translation:
神谷优希不是个普通女孩……
她是个自己承认、旁人也公认的变态少女。而且她全家都是变态，日常生活自然也绝不寻常。

她变态到连学校老师都看得出来。
尽管如此，她每天依然过得快快乐乐！

这样的家庭一起去温泉旅行，天知道会发生什么！
究竟会有怎样一段事故不断的旅程等着他们……

[译编自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ086023.html]DLsite Maniax[/url]]
